temporal_semantics.event_anchor_timestamp_utc: The governed exchange-session open represented by the Event Instance.
temporal_semantics.event_instance_available_at_utc: First time the governed Event Instance is legally observable.
temporal_semantics.event_window_binding_available_at_utc: First time the exact Event Window binding is legally available.
temporal_semantics.instrument_projection_available_at_utc: First time the instrument projection is legally available.
temporal_semantics.market_state_available_at_utc: Availability timestamp of the exact Market State dependency.
temporal_semantics.event_state_as_of_utc: Maximum source-information timestamp incorporated into the Event State record.
temporal_semantics.event_state_available_at_utc: First legal delivery time of the complete Event State record.

restriction_domains.event_state_provenance_restriction_codes: Scientific and construction lineage; not executable replay policy.
restriction_domains.component_replay_restriction_codes: Restrictions attached to Event Instance, Event Window, Instrument Projection and Market State dependency.

fail_closed_rules: Missing dependency availability evidence blocks decision-safe replay.
A dependency marked research_only or blocked prevents decision_safe delivery.
Event State restrictions must not be weaker than any dependency restriction.
decision_timestamp or event_anchor alone never authorizes delivery.
Market State and Event State identities are not interchangeable.
